# SignalR

- Keep hubs thin.
- Put business logic in services.
- Authorize hub connections and sensitive methods.
- Use groups for scoped notifications.
- Design for reconnect and duplicate delivery.
- Do not rely on transient client connection IDs as durable user identity.
- Avoid sending large payloads repeatedly.
